state:
Goal `core-response-and-1-more` is reached. All ten of `Core\Response`'s members and
`Core\Response\Stream::write` carry every feature proof: `about.md`, three examples with `.nvsr`
requests, the attack, the bench record in `docs/perf/members.ndjson`, a `covers:` line in
`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/response.rs`'s `tests` module, and a plain card. `Core\Response\Stream` has
its class card and is gone from `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`. Both stage 2 checks,
`bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Response'` and `--group 'Core\Response\Stream'`, pass, and
so do `bun nv verify --doc`, `bun nv owners --closes` and `bun nv playbook --closes`. Nothing is
blocked.

Off a connection, `Core\Response::stream` writes each chunk to the program's own output, so an
example about a streamed body shows it through `nvs run --request` exactly like a whole body. A
bench of a member cheaper than about 50 ns needs 400000 iterations. At 20000 the tool's noise floor
cuts `ns_per_op` to `0.0`.
